scenarios.question: What is the Atlas standard return window, and when does its refund arrive?
scenarios.rendered_answer_and_sources:
What is the Atlas standard return window, and when does its refund arrive?

Atlas accepts unused standard goods within 21 calendar days of delivery. [meridian.pdf, p. 1]

Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within five business days after warehouse inspection. [meridian.pdf, p. 1]

meridian.pdf — page 1

Atlas returns
SYNTHETIC / FICTIF — meridian-synthetic-v1 — physical page 1
Atlas accepts unused standard goods within 21 calendar days of delivery. A return
needs an authorization code from the Atlas returns desk. Approved refunds are issued
to the original payment method within five business days after warehouse inspection.
Shipping charges are excluded. A warranty repair is a separate process and does not
extend this return window. The Boreal desk has a different policy, even when the item
has the same catalogue description. A customer who sends an item without authorization
receives a request for the missing code; the parcel is not automatically approved. The
delivery date, not the order date, starts the window. Returned goods are inspected
before being added to sellable inventory. An acceptance decision concerns the physical

meridian.pdf — page 3

Atlas warranty workshop
SYNTHETIC / FICTIF — meridian-synthetic-v1 — physical page 3
The Atlas workshop covers manufacturing faults for 90 calendar days after delivery.
Its remedy is repair, not a standard return refund. Cosmetic wear and accidental water
damage are excluded. The customer supplies a purchase reference and a description of
the fault before receiving workshop instructions. Warranty eligibility does not depend
on the unopened seal used by the Boreal return policy. A repair request does not reset
the original delivery date or the 21-day Atlas standard return window. The workshop
records the fault category separately from the return reason so analysts do not merge
the two processes. A repaired product goes through a functional check before dispatch.
This document specifies no repair completion deadline and promises no replacement

scenarios.question: Quel est le numérateur du taux de clic de campagne ?
scenarios.rendered_answer_and_sources:
Quel est le numérateur du taux de clic de campagne ?

Le numérateur du taux de clic de campagne est le nombre de destinataires uniques ayant cliqué. [meridian.pdf, p. 12]
